description: Restores a backup into an existing volume (volumeId), an instance's volume (instanceId), or a new one (volumeName). Poll list_volumes for the restored volume. DISASTER RECOVERY (the original VM is gone, so its volume died with it): restore with volumeName to rebuild the data as a NEW volume. To bring the MACHINE back, pass that volume as create_instance's boot_volume_id - it boots from the restored disk, so the VM returns with its filesystem intact and nothing to mount. Use attach_volume instead only when you want the data as an EXTRA disk on an existing machine (then get_ssh_command -> lsblk -> mount). A restored volume is inert until it is booted from or attached.

backupId.description: ID of the backup to restore (see list_backups).

instanceId.description: Optional: restore into this instance's volume (resolved automatically). The target volume must be available (detached), so stop the instance first.

provisioning_mode.description: This operation is not included in the free resource entitlement. Review paid pricing first.

volumeId.description: Optional: restore into this existing volume.

volumeName.description: Optional: name for a new volume to restore into. Omit volumeId and instanceId to restore into a new volume.

name: restore_backup
title: Restore backup
